title: Changing only Min through the parts import writes an Import entry
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test, with Min 2 and Max 6.
  • Have a parts import file with one row for part A with the same values except Min 4 (Max stays 6).
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (Settings, then Data Import, then Inventory).
custom_steps:
1. Upload the file.
  2. Run the import.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  6. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file is ready to import.

Step 2:

  • The import finishes without errors.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • Part A is listed with Min 4.

Step 6:

  • An entry reads "Min/Max updated | Min: 2 → 4 | Source: Import", with no Max pair.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S10-R22a: “Changing Min or Max writes "Min/Max updated | {changes} | Source: {source}" to the part's Part History. {changes} is "Min: {old} → {new}" when only Min changed, "Max: {old} → {new}" when only Max changed, and both, Min first, joined by " | " when both changed. The source is "Edit Part" or "Import". No entry is written when neither value changed.”
  • S5-E1: “The parts CSV import can change Min, Max and bin quantities on an untracked part. The values are saved the same way as on a tracked part, and a Min or Max change is written to Part History (S10-R22a).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
